# mobius-cli 0.17.10

- Restyle the terminal client with Nord frost braille dither on a transparent background: dotted rules, open-right decision cards, a dotted composer rim and a sweeping loader replace solid rules, boxes and the colour shimmer; only small label chips paint the terminal background. [d8aeddbe](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/commit/d8aeddbe)
- Settle a running tool's title into place through dither glyphs over 450 ms. [2acb57c9](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/commit/2acb57c9)
- Head the chat and full-screen pages with a dithered sun on a horizon. [eecbb457](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/commit/eecbb457)

Bundles gateway **0.17.10** and uses protocol **103**; it cannot connect to protocol 102 gateways, so upgrade the gateway at the same time.
